en: So Bun has a lot to offer.
One quick note about using Bun and about
this course though. If you wanna use Bun to
follow along or in your own projects, you
obviously need to install it and you can do
so from bun.com. There you'll find simple
commands you can run no matter if you're on
Linux, macOS, or on Windows. And that is how
you can put Bun onto your system and then
use it just as you'll see it in this course.
But speaking about this course, This course
is about showing you and teaching you what
Bun has to offer, giving you an idea of what
you can do with Bun and how you would be
doing this.
It's not a course where we will write code
line by line and you can type along though,
simply because
with AI, that's just not really how I build
software anymore. And you might not be doing
it like that either. You probably don't
write all the code anymore, but it is more
important than ever to know what to ask the
AI for, which features you wanted to use,
which Bun APIs, in the case of Bun, you want
to point it at. And that's therefore exactly
what this course is about, giving you a good
understanding of what Bun has to offer, what
to watch out for, and how to use these Bun
features so that you
can build applications on top of Bun with AI
and still understand what the AI is doing
and steer the AI in the right direction.
That is my goal with this course. And
therefore, now let's dive in and let's learn
a bit more about Bun.
